headline: Amphenol Announces Two-for-One Stock Split and Third Quarter 2026 Dividend
summary: WALLINGFORD, Conn., August 06, 2026--Amphenol Corporation (NYSE: APH) today announced that at its meeting held on August 5, 2026, the Company’s Board of Directors approved a two-for-one stock split to be paid in the form of a stock dividend. Each Amphenol shareholder of record at the close of business on August 17, 2026 will receive one additional share for every share held on the record date.
